title: GUEST HOUSE
notes: The title block prints 1/8" = 1'-0" and the sheet's own 31'-0" dimension is 7.75 inches long on a 17-inch page. 31 feet in 7.75 inches is 1/4" to the foot, and all six dimensions agree on it. The printed note is wrong, which is a common defect on a real set. Scale is NOT scored here; what is scored is that the app reads the dimensions and says the two disagree.
